page.layout: One page of text; a decorative woodcut headpiece at top; a dedication title in capitals above a block of text; a decorative woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph; page number at top right corner. No margin notes.

main_text.head: ORNATISS. NOBILI, ET Patricio Norico Do. Georgio Lindnero Ioannes Iacomotus Barrensis S. P. D.
main_text.p: VM te crebra vti viderem conuersatione clarifs. Viri D. Ioannis Paludij Philophili, coepi te amare ex iisdem causis quibus ille te amat. Intellexi enim quod ipsi carus sis, & ob familiae tuae praestantiam, & cognationem cum summis viris Camerariis, ob eruditionem quoque non vulgarem, quam ex indefessa bonorum autorum lectione tibi comparasti. Et quod caetera vincit ob virtutem tuam ac fidem singularem ipsi in itinere ex Germania hucusque satis probatam. Certe vt cognationem quandam inter nos natura ipsa constituit, ita tamen facilius rapimur in amorem illorum qui amantur ab aliis, quique

page.notes: The woodcut initial "V" is joined to "VM" as "VM" with the decorative capital; the first word reads "VM" (Cum). Page number 175 is printed at the top right. Some letters in the body are damaged by the woodcut initial and by print wear; "ille" and "amat" are as legible on the scan. Words such as "fidem" and "Hucusque" are read with some uncertainty ("hucusque" printed as "hucque" with a broken letter, marked as read).
